d.d: A follower of Pythagoras; someone who believes in or advocates Pythagoreanism.
Pertaining to the philosophy of Pythagoras.
Following the lifestyle advocated by the Pythagoreans; specifically, vegetarian.
Any of the family Pythonidae of nonvenomous constrictor snakes.
Any member of the comedy troupe Monty Python: Graham Chapman, John Cleese, Terry Gilliam, Eric Idle, Terry Jones or Michael Palin.
d.x: John Cleese is perhaps the best-known of the Pythons.
